name: Sindhi Biryani
description: A bold Sindhi-style biryani layered with basmati rice, spiced chicken, potatoes, tomatoes, yogurt and fragrant whole spices.
method: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 minutes.
Fry the onions until golden, then add chicken, ginger-garlic paste and biryani masala.
Add tomatoes, yogurt and potatoes and cook until the chicken is tender and the masala thickens.
Boil the soaked rice in salted water until about three-quarters cooked, then drain.
Layer rice over the chicken masala with mint, coriander, green chilies and lemon.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes before gently mixing and serving.
